entries.final_answer: Agent choice (out of contract, product owner 2026-10-07): option A — a file: include inside fetched content resolves against the remote URL (RFC 3986) and is fetched; nested https:// and http:// includes are allowed; a URL cycle exits 4; everything reached through a remote include is remote and read-only.
options: file: resolves against the remote URL (fetched from the same server); nested https:// includes allowed; a URL cycle exits 4
Remote files may contain https:// includes but a file: include in remote content exits 4
Remote files may contain no includes at all (any include string in remote content exits 4)
entries.question: A remote YAML include (https://…/team.yaml) itself contains include strings — file:x.yaml, or another https:// URL. What do they mean?
